findings.result: Both enabled modes reject malformed subject timestamps. Disabled ignores the attribute; missing is distinct. Go checks readiness before cutoff validation.
Both prepare activation into valid/missing/invalid states and gate flag-wide activation errors on effective future policy. Unreachable malformed allocations remain relevant.
Both skip doLog-eligible allocations before targeting. Future compares strict activation-before-cutoff; no history, wall-clock schedule or assignment freeze.
Go returns NoopProvider before mode validation and guards excludes at the allocation loop. These remain scoped Go decisions; browser still calls its no-op exclusion helper.
Browser uses the recorded normalized parser. Go intentionally uses time.RFC3339Nano/time.Time JSON parsing. Lowercase and parser extensions remain a recorded conflict, not a new common grammar.
Browser validates acknowledgements against effective policy. Absent cutoff omits options; unfiltered requests reject explicit filtering.

limits: Source inspection at merged PR heads. No fresh Go native test, runtime, deployment, or whole-source refinement claim.
